title: Distribution characteristics and environmental risk assessment of bisphenol analogues in the lower reaches of the Yangtze River
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00294J, Paper
Wanyu Li, Wenxuan Ma, Jiajun Chang, Yao Xiao, Rui Wang, Zhiliang Zhu, Daqiang Yin, Yue Li, Yanling Qiu
Water samples were collected from cities along the lower reaches of the Yangtze River for concentration monitoring to explore the occurrence characteristics of BPs, analyze their sources, and assess their environmental risks.
